messages:
Anna Li: Quick check — I just pushed the API tag v1.8.0-rc1 to api-repo. Can folks confirm we need the exact same tag in runtime/console/sdk or should those be independent patch tags?
Ken Park: Recommend same tag for this cut to keep the release matrix simple. runtime needs the generated protobufs in sync though.
Jamie Ortiz: console already has a changelog entry under releases/1.8.0.md but I haven't tagged yet. Will wait for confirmation.
Samir R.: SDKs will get a small version bump (patch) because of packaging changes. I can do sdk-js -> 1.8.0 and sdk-py -> 1.8.0.post1 if we want to keep implementation differences explicit.
Anna Li: Ok — meta decision: use unified tag for core (api, runtime, console) and patch variants for SDKs. Does that sound good? @Ken @Jamie
Ken Park: 👍 sounds good. Can we target tagging in 45m? Cutoff is at 16:00 UTC.
Jamie Ortiz: I can push the console tag once I see the api tag is final. Will also add a short note in the console changelog about runtime compatibility.
Samir R.: Will open PRs for the SDK packages now and request reviews. ETA ~30m.
Anna Li: rl-ci-bot, can we run the matrix once the three core tags exist?
rl-ci-bot: ci/status: queued job created for release-matrix-run. Will post updates here.
Ken Park: Minor checklist for whoever tags: 1) ensure api tag includes proto commit X (sha: d4f3a2c), 2) runtime builds with that proto, 3) console points to same api client.
Jamie Ortiz: Posting the exact git commands for tagging so everyone uses the same pattern:
```
# from repo root
git fetch origin main
git checkout -b release/1.8.0-rc1 origin/main
git tag -a v1.8.0-rc1 -m "release candidate 1"
git push origin v1.8.0-rc1
```
Samir R.: noted. I'll mirror that for sdk repos but append .post1 for python where needed.
rl-ci-bot: ci/status: initial matrix started (jobs: lint, unit, integration).
Anna Li: If tests pass, I'll mark the rc as final and we can promote to v1.8.0. If anything flaps, we'll hold and open a tiny rollback PR.
Ken Park: I'll babysit the runtime builds during the window. Ping me if anything times out.
Jamie Ortiz: tagging console now -> pusing tag... done. v1.8.0-rc1 pushed to console.
rl-ci-bot: ci/status: console checks passed.
Samir R.: sdk PRs open: #462 (js), #463 (py). Requesting quick review from @Ken.
Ken Park: Reviewing now. ETA 10m.
Anna Li: Thanks all — will watch the matrix and update this thread. :thumbsup:
rl-ci-bot: ci/status: full matrix green. All core repos passed integration tests.
Anna Li: Great. I'm promoting rc -> final tag across api/runtime/console in ~5m.
Ken Park: Confirmed runtime build artifact uploaded to S3 path s3://redwood-builds/1.8.0/runtime.tar.gz
Jamie Ortiz: Console release notes published.
Samir R.: SDKs merged and published to npm (1.8.0) and pypi (1.8.0.post1).
Anna Li: Done — tags promoted to v1.8.0. Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short changelog digest for marketing.
Ken Park: Nice work. :tada:
rl-ci-bot: release/1.8.0 - deployment hooks triggered for staging and canary cohorts."
